content: Prefer Server Components for initial Supabase reads (direct server client call). Use TanStack Query 5.101 on the client for interactive views needing caching/mutation/optimistic updates (kanban drag moves, dashboard filters); has DevTools, robust invalidation, HydrationBoundary for server-seeded data. SWR is lighter (4.2KB vs 13.4KB) if bundle size is binding, but TanStack Query mutation ergonomics fit kanban drag better.
